definitions.gloss: oral examination; oral test; viva voce
definitions.explanation: An examination conducted verbally rather than in writing. The examinee answers questions spoken by the examiner. Common in academic settings such as graduate school defenses and professional licensing.

examples.japanese: {口頭|こうとう}{試験|しけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{筆記|ひっき}{試験|しけん}→筆記試験：19043_hikkishiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口頭|こうとう}{試験|しけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an oral exam after the written exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学院|だいがくいん}→大学院：04783_daigakuin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{口頭|こうとう}{試験|しけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: In the graduate school entrance exam, you have to explain your research plan in the oral examination.

notes:
An examination where questions are asked and answered verbally. Distinguished from ⟦{筆記|ひっき}{試験|しけん}→筆記試験：19043_hikkishiken⟧ (written examination). Also sometimes called ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ when it resembles an interview format.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口頭|こうとう}{試験|しけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to take an oral exam
- {口頭|こうとう}{試験|しけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}する→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧: to pass an oral exam
- {口頭|こうとう}{試験|しけん}{官|かん}: oral examiner
- ⟦{口頭|こうとう}{試問|しもん}→口頭試問：23321_koutoushimon⟧: oral questioning (slightly more formal variant)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{筆記|ひっき}{試験|しけん}→筆記試験：19043_hikkishiken⟧: written examination — answers given in writing
- ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧: interview — broader term; may assess personality and attitude, not just knowledge
- ⟦{口頭|こうとう}{発表|はっぴょう}→口頭発表：24471_koutouhappyou⟧: oral presentation — a one-way presentation rather than a question-and-answer format

USAGE:
Common in graduate school admissions, thesis defenses, professional licensing exams (medical, legal), and language proficiency tests.
